proof_nl: Let x be any real number. By the standard definition of the fractional part function, frac(x) is exactly the difference between x and its integer part floor(x). Hence frac(x) = x - floor(x), as claimed.
solver_summary: The statement is immediate from the definition of the fractional-part function.
